rationale: Correct the existing Phoenix Renewables record and supersede the census's queued ADD_OWNER because ArcLight Capital is the shortened census label for the existing ArcLight Capital Partners organization. ArcLight's current portfolio-services page identifies Phoenix as a Fund VIII operating-renewables portfolio managed through SkyVest, and ArcLight's live investments page marks Phoenix Current. No second manager or ownership period is warranted. No direct source supports the existing 2024 ownership-entry year or a Phoenix headquarters, so both become null. Correct the historical wording so ArcLight's July 2024 SkyVest launch is not presented as a Phoenix acquisition or as a release that itself named Phoenix. ArcLight's 2025 ESG report supports Phoenix's Fund VIII attribution, establishment under SkyVest and 467 MW reported scale. No Phoenix-level sale, signed pending exit, dissolution, successor or rename was identified through August 14, 2026; a July 2026 FERC filing concerns an asset-level add-on beneath the portfolio and does not alter manager-level ownership.

beforeImage.name: Phoenix Renewables
beforeImage.description: Phoenix Renewables is an operating portfolio of renewable generation assets managed within ArcLight's renewables services platform. The assets serve wholesale power markets through an asset-heavy operating model focused on existing wind and solar infrastructure rather than early-stage development. ArcLight's portfolio-services materials identify Phoenix Renewables as one of the initial ArcLight Fund VIII portfolio investments managed through SkyVest Renewables. The platform is therefore tied to operating renewable asset management and commercialization rather than a standalone equipment or services business. ArcLight's renewable-services platform disclosed the management structure in 2024, while public sources reviewed do not disclose Phoenix's separate founding year or ownership percentages.

milestones.event: Phoenix Renewables became part of ArcLight's operating-focused renewables initiative.
ArcLight launched SkyVest Renewables and disclosed Phoenix Renewables as one of the initial Fund VIII portfolios it would manage.

afterImage.name: Phoenix Renewables
afterImage.description: Phoenix Renewables is an ArcLight Infrastructure Partners Fund VIII portfolio of operating renewable generation assets managed through ArcLight's SkyVest Renewables portfolio-services platform. ArcLight's current portfolio-services page identifies Phoenix and Thunderbird as the initial Fund VIII operating portfolios managed by SkyVest, while ArcLight's 2025 ESG report reports 467 MW for Phoenix. Phoenix is counted as the manager-level portfolio; SkyVest is the management platform, and individual assets or projects beneath Phoenix are not separate PortCos. ArcLight's live investments page lists Phoenix as Current. Public sources reviewed do not disclose an exact ownership-entry date, stake, website, founding year, headquarters, or a Phoenix-level exit through August 14, 2026.

milestones.event: ArcLight reported that it had established Phoenix Renewables under SkyVest Renewables as an operating-renewables portfolio with 467 MW.

ArcLight launched SkyVest Renewables to manage operating renewable assets; ArcLight's current portfolio-services page separately identifies Phoenix as an initial Fund VIII portfolio managed through SkyVest.
